description: Blackstone Inc. is the world's largest alternative asset manager, seeking to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies and assets in which it invests. Its more than $1.3 trillion in Total Assets Under Management as of December 31, 2025 include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, credit, real assets, secondaries and hedge funds. It invests across asset classes on behalf of pension funds, insurance companies and individual investors using a solutions-oriented approach, and believes its scale, diversified business, long record of investment performance, rigorous investment process and strong client relationships position it to continue to perform well in a variety of market conditions, expand its assets under management and innovate.
